title: FPQC descent of sections of a quasi-coherent pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent] with pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]; pullbacks of sections along morphisms of schemes and the composition isomorphisms $(b\circ a)^*\cong a^*b^*$ identifying them are those of [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. For an fpqc covering family $\{g_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], write $f_i=f\circ g_i$. If sections $s_i\in\Gamma(T_i,f_i^*\mathcal F)$ have equal pullbacks to every fibre product $T_i\times_T T_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product], then there exists a unique section $s\in\Gamma(T,f^*\mathcal F)$ whose pullback along every $g_i$ is $s_i$.

source.place: Tag 03DT, Lemma 35.8.1 (label lemma-sheaf-condition-holds), proof using Proposition 35.5.2 (Tag 023T)

proof.text: Put $N=f^*\mathcal F$, a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_T$-module by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent], and identify $g_i^*N$ with $f_i^*\mathcal F$ by [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. A section $s_i$ determines the $\mathcal O_{T_i}$-linear map $\varphi_i:\mathcal O_{T_i}\to g_i^*N$, $a\mapsto a s_i$. Conversely an $\mathcal O_{T_i}$-linear sheaf map from $\mathcal O_{T_i}$ is determined by its value at $1$ on every open, since $\varphi_i(a)=a\varphi_i(1)$ and the local values of $1$ are restrictions of the global $1$. Thus sections and such module maps correspond, compatibly with pullback; the source is the structure sheaf under pullback by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf].

source.place: Tag 03DT, proof of lemma-sheaf-condition-holds, sentence reinterpreting the sections as maps from the structure sheaf

proof.text: On $T_i\times_T T_j$, the two pullbacks of $\varphi_i$ and $\varphi_j$ are maps from the structure sheaf to the common pullback of $N$. Their values at $1$ are the two pullbacks of $s_i$ and $s_j$, equal by hypothesis; by the correspondence in step 1 the maps agree. These maps therefore form a morphism between the canonical descent data on $\mathcal O_T$ and $N$ for the fpqc family $\{g_i\}$.

source.place: Tag 03DT, proof of lemma-sheaf-condition-holds, compatibility with the canonical descent data

proof.text: Apply the full faithfulness clause of [lem-pc-fpqc-descent] (Stacks 023T) to the fpqc covering $\{g_i:T_i\to T\}$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] and to the two quasi-coherent modules $\mathcal O_T$ and $N$. The compatible maps $\varphi_i$ descend to a unique $\mathcal O_T$-linear map $\varphi:\mathcal O_T\to N$ whose pullbacks are $\varphi_i$. Set $s=\varphi_T(1)$. Step 1 shows that its pullback to each $T_i$ is $s_i$. If $s'$ has the same pullbacks, the associated map $a\mapsto as'$ has the same pullbacks as $\varphi$ and hence equals $\varphi$ by faithfulness; evaluating at $1$ gives $s'=s$.
